title: Formalization notes for Fermat's Last Theorem
description: Planning notes for the polynomial and regular-prime targets in index.qmd.

The [human chapter](index.qmd) describes polynomial proofs by descent, Mason–Stothers, and Riemann–Hurwitz, followed by Kummer's two cases for regular primes. The paired sidecar tracks the targets in that chapter.

Start with a predicate for primitive solutions over a principal ideal domain. Mathlib's `not_fermat_42`, `fermatLastTheoremFour`, `Polynomial.abc`, and `Polynomial.flt` provide results to check against the corresponding human targets. Compare the proof routes separately where the chapter calls for a specific argument.

For the cyclotomic coprimality statement, the allowed positive-characteristic case requires interpreting the coefficient ring generated by the root of unity as the image of the integer evaluation map. Keep the comparison with the characteristic-zero cyclotomic integers explicit when using it in Kummer's argument.
